item.title: Rallying Cry – June 9, 2026
item.description: Serena Williams made a triumphant return at Queen’s, Rivian kicked off R2 SUV deliveries, a drone boat saved downed US Army pilots in a first-of-its-kind rescue, and David Sinclair is testing rejuvenation drugs in the XPrize—plus, tiny muffin tin recipes and a deep dive into hip-hop history!
